headline: US Army successfully destroys toxic explosives stockpile in Iowa with zero airborne lead
label: NEWS
caption:
US military officials have hailed the controlled detonation of nearly five tonnes of volatile explosives in Iowa as a huge success. 

According to the BBC, the Army detonated the aging lead azide compound at an ammunition plant after pausing plans several times due to public outcry and legal challenges. 

Environmental Protection Agency Administrator Lee Zeldin stated on X that air monitors detected zero airborne lead following the explosion. 

President Donald Trump said reports showed mitigation efforts far exceeded expectations as teams continue to collect post detonation samples from homes and parks.
